evals.name: zee-after-the-fact
evals.prompt: Make a replay of the Z→ee notebook session I ran in ~/mcp-demo/zee yesterday, like the other replays in this repo.
evals.expected_output: A story folder dated by the session (US Central) with redacted events.json and a story.json whose cards are checked against their events; no username, hub URL or account ID; knowledge-base results omitted; nothing committed.

evals.name: marked-span
evals.prompt: I marked part of my debugging session with /replay-start and /replay-stop. Turn that part into a replay.
evals.expected_output: Only the span between the markers, without the marker exchange; every planted secret masked (token, password, username, colleague, internal hosts, IPs, email, hub URL, account ID), including the one before the start marker never appearing.

evals.name: generic-coding
evals.prompt: Turn my wordfreq coding session into a replay page so I can show students how Claude Code works through a small task with tests.
evals.expected_output: A replay of a session with no MCP servers: no atlas-af or HTCondor assumptions in the story, polling left off, generic stats; commentary aimed at students.
